study: Pilot field sensitivity to lateral electrode-center displacement

mesh.backend: Gmsh OpenCASCADE full disk with 12 independently positioned circular holes

electrostatics.solver: P4 Galerkin Laplace problem, full asymmetric domain, pyamg smoothed-aggregation preconditioned conjugate gradients for real and imaginary parts

rf_comparison.standing_quadrature: sine quadrature only, matching V4 definition
rf_comparison.retention_language: finite-time survival through the stated horizon only

budget.checkpoint: each geometry mesh, solver stage, and completed field solve is fsync/atomic recorded
